local.h: Medicaid cuts strip coverage from refugees
local.b: New federal restrictions effective Oct. 1 removed Medicaid coverage from certain legal immigrants, including refugees and trafficking victims, an estimated hundreds of thousands of people.

local.h: Chicago Bungalow Association leader dies at 71

local.h: France and Germany clash over EU budget
local.b: France and Germany are at loggerheads over whether to make deep cuts in the EU's next seven-year budget, a fight expected to run past the end of the year.
